The chicken is salted a day ahead and roasted upside down in a preheated cast
iron skillet. Breast and legs are done at different temperatures, so the legs
come off when the breast is ready and go back in on their own.

## Ingredients

- 1 whole chicken
- Kosher salt
- Olive oil

## Method

1. Salt the chicken thoroughly all over and inside the cavity. Refrigerate for
   at least 12 hr.
2. Put a cast iron skillet in the oven and preheat to 425 °F.
3. Take the chicken out of the fridge and rub it with a little olive oil.
4. Set the chicken breast side down in the hot skillet. Roast for 15 min.
5. Lower the oven to 375 °F. Roast until the thickest part of the breast reads
   160–165 °F.
6. Take the chicken out of the oven. Cut off the legs and return them to the
   skillet in the oven.
7. Roast the legs until the thigh reads 180–190 °F.
8. Serve.
